newsitem.title: USA: Safeco narrows homeowners insurance loss.
newsitem.headline: Safeco narrows homeowners insurance loss.

text.p: Safeco Corp said Monday its quarterly results benefitted from fewer weather-related catastrophes and its homeowners insurance narrowing its losses.
The insurer posted a $117 million net income, or $0.93 a share, for the quarter ended June 30, compared with a $106.0 million net, or $0.84 a share, the year before.
A First Call consensus estimate of 20 analysts had put the company's earnings at $0.80 a share for the second quarter.
Safeco' s operating income, which excludes gains from selling investments, reached $0.83 a share in the second quarter, compared with $0.74 a share last year.

The company's property and casualty operations posted a $24 million underwriting profit, compared with $4.4 million last year. Safeco attributed the improvement primarily to the its homeowners line narrowing its underwriting loss to $4.4 million in the quarter, compared with a $19 million loss last year.

Safeco added continuing good results in personal auto, surety and commercial insurance contributed to its property and casualty quarterly pretax income of $93 million (including dividends and interest), compared with a $74 million profit last year.

The company's life and health operations reported a $35.7 million quarterly pretax profit compared with $37.3 million last year. Safeco's real estate, credit and asset management operations reported quarterly profits of $2.8 million, $5.3 million and $1.4 million, respectively.
The company's stock closed at 45-13/16 Friday.
